title: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V of 1983
CODE OF CRIMINAL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE V of 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 10th
February, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the Present is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Code of Criminal
Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the Present is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 510,
Act V of 1898.-In the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), in
section 510, after the word and comma "Government,", the words and
commas "or of the Chief Chemist of the Pakistan Security Printing
Corporation, Limited'.", shall be inserted.
